name: Template parity: text and button flows
description: Tests that browse button, browse text, category name, and numeric input all trigger template sends via the selection resolver. Requires dev server running with TWILIO_PRODUCT_LIST_SID set.

steps.note: Greeting — should trigger welcome template or ack
Browse button click — should send category list-picker template with exactly 6 variables
Browse text — should also send category list-picker template (text parity)
Category name text — should send product list-picker for that category
Numeric input with active pending_selection (product_list) — should resolve to first product
